title: Compression Trinity: Exploring Sparsity, Quantization, and Low-Rank Approximations for LLM Compression
abstract: arXiv:2608.24070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prohibitive computational and environmental costs impede the scalable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional compression techniques (sparsity, quantization, low-rank approximations) are typically applied in isolation, and each hits an accuracy-efficiency wall. This thesis proposes the "Compression Trinity," a unified framework that applies the three pillars jointly: sparsity to reduce computation, quantization to minimize memory bandwidth, and low-rank approximations to recover accuracy. To accelerate pretraining, we apply the Trinity to the optimizer and model architecture. MKOR approximates curvature via block-diagonal sparsity and low-rank inversion, maintaining numerical stability for quantized states; it reduces curvature update complexity from $O(d^3)$ to $O(d^2)$ and accelerates convergence by up to 1.85x over KFAC. translated_title: 压缩三位一体：探索稀疏性、量化和低秩近似在大型语言模型压缩中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24070v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：巨大的计算和环境成本阻碍了大型语言模型（LLM）的可扩展部署。传统的压缩技术（稀疏性、量化、低秩近似）通常单独应用，每种方法都遇到了精度-效率的瓶颈。本论文提出了“压缩三位一体”（Compression Trinity），一个统一框架，联合应用这三个支柱：稀疏性用于减少计算量，量化用于最小化内存带宽，低秩近似用于恢复精度。为了加速预训练，我们将三位一体应用于优化器和模型架构。MKOR通过块对角稀疏性和低秩逆近似来近似曲率，保持量化状态的数值稳定性；它将曲率更新复杂度从$O(d^3)$降低到$O(d^2)$，并将收敛速度比KFAC加速最多1.85倍。SLoPe通过用于N:M稀疏性的双剪枝反向传播，将训练加速最多1.25倍。
tldr: 本文提出“压缩三位一体”统一框架，联合应用稀疏性、量化和低秩近似来压缩LLM，并通过MKOR和SLoPe技术分别将预训练收敛速度提升至1.85倍和1.25倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "Compression Trinity" unified framework that jointly applies sparsity, quantization, and low-rank approximations to compress LLMs, achieving up to 1.85x faster convergence via MKOR and 1.25x faster training via SLoPe.
